next_steps.action: Measure the adapter voltage at the DC jack first, then at the input MOSFET drain, then at the charger IC ACIN pin. Walk forward until the voltage stops.

measure.what: Adapter voltage at jack, MOSFET drain, charger ACIN
measure.where: DC jack center pin -> input fuse -> input MOSFET drain -> charger ACIN pin
measure.expected: Adapter nominal at every point along the path (typically 19-20 V).
measure.safety: Adapter input is high-current at 19 V. Probe carefully; do not short the jack tip to the chassis.

interpretations.if_result: Voltage present at the jack but missing at MOSFET drain
interpretations.then: Input fuse or current-sense resistor is open. Replace with same rating.

interpretations.if_result: Voltage present at MOSFET drain but missing at charger ACIN
interpretations.then: Input MOSFET is off. Charger IC is not driving the gate. Diagnose charger IC enable (see RULE_CHG_002).
Input path is good. If adapter rail still considered faulty, look at the charger's buck output (battery charge path) instead.
